label: step right after a 0, in sequences starting with 3 (orig steps 3-6)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.003% of steps). Fires late in the original phase (t=3..6, peaking at t=4) or at the delimiter, at the step right after the digit 0 was input (prev_tok=0 carries 88% of mass), and almost only when the sequence begins with 3 (90% of mass; a few with first token q). Rate rises with the number of digits in the sequence, and is larger when q is the second token (3 q ... 0) and when 0s repeat (the max 3.67 is on 3 q 0 0). Never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. The conjunction catches ~78% of activation mass, but most matching steps stay silent (precision ~6%), so an unidentified extra condition gates it. Adding q as the second token raises precision to ~49% but drops recall to ~21%.
